name: hostkey-ask-before-any-auth

graded_by.test: worker/tests/test_device_login.py — test_the_probe_sends_no_user_name_and_nothing_is_authenticated_before_accept: the test server sees a key exchange and then a close, no USERAUTH_REQUEST, before the answer

description: In prompt mode the worker asks about a first-use key before anything is authenticated: `hostkey_ask` comes first, and no `auth_prompt` comes before the core's `hostkey_answer`. The worker's probe runs the SSH key exchange only, offering public-key host-key algorithms and no certificate algorithm, and sends no user name and no SSH_MSG_USERAUTH_REQUEST (asyncssh get_server_host_key waits for key exchange only), so the device sees no login name until the operator has accepted. At most one `hostkey_ask` per connect, and never a `hostkey` event in prompt mode.

messages.note: before any auth_prompt; the probe sent no user name
the first prompt comes after the answer
